scope: Offline controlled CPU retrieval study on public source records; no generated-answer or independent factual accuracy certificate.

frozen_protocol.query: source-independent existing locality alias resolver, one resolved question; no LLM, no topic/gold mappings
frozen_protocol.context: same source conditions attached to every returned unit; no truncation to game budgets
frozen_protocol.reranker_limit: Pinned mMARCO: query bounded to 120 tokenizer tokens, query-passage pair to 512 with only_second truncation, unchanged across strategies; large windows may lose trailing ranking text, never delivered evidence.
frozen_protocol.transport: stable markers removed; original metadata sidecar equalized only in controlled extraction track, not native import
frozen_protocol.timing: local warm OS cache; cold model load reported separately; no cache sharing between strategies; semantic sentence encoding included in prep

protocol_amendments: Before examining nonbaseline configuration outcomes: fixed split-span/whitespace scoring, duplicate conditions in evidence, preparation/token cost reuse and public source filtering. Baseline index inputs/evidence unchanged; its stored selections rescored.

Final scoring revision: union literal body and attached-condition intervals, accept any exact repeated occurrence, reject changed word boundaries during transport alignment. Frozen questions, gold spans, model inputs and stored selections unchanged. All stored selections rescored; no claim of external preregistration.

Two exploratory controls specified after inspecting the first four structural results, before inspecting semantic/overlap outcomes: semantic boundaries on body sentences without shared headers, and real 30-token overlap at the 180-token split. A third later control uses body-only dense and source-context BM25, motivated by read-only inspection of Giana Turismo ingestion code. Not an independent confirmatory family.

repeatability_observation.note: Same inputs and coverage; first-run aggregate from recorded tool output, second from final JSON. Different local process/run conditions, not an interleaved statistical experiment. Roughly 19% time variation; do not treat the semantic candidate's roughly 15% observed speed difference as established.

recommendation.ingestion: Self-contained validated gianna.corpus.v1 JSON; file format itself does not improve embeddings.
recommendation.conservative_default: Keep source-context logical records and hybrid retrieval plus reranking for maximal coverage in this set.
recommendation.advanced_candidate: Body-only semantic boundary detection with contextual 240-token chunks tied maximal source coverage, modestly lower observed query time and context, but higher build cost; validate integrated pipeline before adoption.
recommendation.latency_candidate: 120-token children returning the original parent record: lower observed reranking time, one additional source-case miss and more index entries.
not_recommended_here: Semantic segmentation with duplicated headings when it yields identical boundaries
Blindly adding all conditions/JSON keys to search representations
recommendation.deployment: No production publication or automatic settings change.

limitations: All file variants derive from the same public corpus, not independent heterogeneous originals.
Narrative views encode body and a subset of metadata, not all fields/bibliography. Native metadata gaps confound view and converter; equalized retrieval explicitly uses a sidecar.
PDF is single-column selectable text; no OCR, complex tables or diagram benchmark. DOCX extraction checked, LibreOffice rendering unavailable.
60 related questions, including 24 agent-designed frozen additions and 58 literal spans; no independent human blind holdout.
17 configurations plus PDF produce 4320 logical case-mode rows, with four identical configurations reused. They are not 4320 independent questions.
Local warm non-randomized timings, ONNX two threads but no whole-process CPU quota. No peak-RAM, concurrent-VPS or end-to-end generation latency certificate.
Small latency differences require interleaved repeated measurement. Source coverage is not answer correctness or independent factual verification.
Multi-record grouping does not implement a production citation/provenance contract. Full production harness and 8K memory behavior not altered or re-evaluated here.
